name: Elemental Workspace Indicator
author: makehasteslowly
description: Hyprland workspace indicators for Omarchy with 4 selectable 5-element traditions (Elemental Icons, Alchemical Symbols, Japanese Godai, Chinese Wu Xing) and live floating workspace window previews.

barWidget.description: Workspace indicators for the 5 elements with live floating workspace previews and 4 symbol styles (Elemental, Alchemy, Japanese Godai, Chinese Wu Xing).

schema.label: Symbol Style
schema.description: Choose between Nerd Font elemental icons (󰈸 󰖌 󰌪 󰖝 󱐋), Alchemical symbols (🜂 🜄 🜃 🜁 ✧), Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空), or Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水). Right-click the widget on the bar to switch anytime.

options.label: 󰈸  Elemental Icons (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Aether)
地  Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空)
木  Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水)

schema.label: Floating Workspace Preview
schema.description: Show a floating preview window with live Wayland window thumbnails when hovering over a workspace indicator.
